data: Information systems (IS) refer to the embedding of work processes, within and across organizations, in information and communication technologies (ICT) such as computers, communications devices and networks that interconnect them. The mediation of work through information systems can save cost and improve quality, potentially granting competitive advantage to organizations that invest in such systems. Data accumulated through the operation of information systems are also further analyzed using statistical algorithms (data analytics) to reveal novel yet reliable patterns that can be exploited to improve the efficiency and quality of work processes.
